method.name: real-review bounded evolution
method.summary: Convert real wins and losses into bounded scoring rules, hard constraints, and protected brave behaviors before publishing.
principles: Learn from winning matches and losing matches.
Fatal risks are hard constraints, not small penalties.
Do not let defensive fixes remove star tempo, lane control, or pressure fire.
Keep one rollback baseline and one coherent hypothesis per cycle.
Use live target pools and real challenge batches for ladder evaluation; simulations are only safety checks.
Do not patch from a single fresh loss unless it is a reproducible hard constraint; cluster real replay tags before changing code.

boundedAxes.purpose: Handle active bullets, aimed shots, overload lanes, hidden shooters, and own bombs before value actions.
requiredTests: hidden shooter lane from a visible bullet
fixed shooter line exposed by a visible bullet

boundedAxes.purpose: Preserve safe star pickups and direct star routes when they are not hard-danger moves.
Choose between star pickup, overload pressure, interception, and lead control by frame value instead of fixed try-order side effects.
requiredTests: lost star race avoids blind chase
overload mirror lost star race opens pressure
hard current danger vetoes value actions

boundedAxes.purpose: Resolve same-row or same-column gunlines by frame cost: take a one-frame exit when already facing off-line, or fire only when already aimed.
Use overload for covered positive-offset pressure, not shield-style direct duels or impossible offset shots.
requiredTests: ordinary fire blocked by hard-wall offset star lane

boundedAxes.purpose: Avoid empty line holds, grass idling, and post-overload gunline stalls.
requiredTests: held strategic grass tile into an action

boundedAxes.purpose: Promote only grass tiles that control star lines, enemy pressure lanes, or overload offset lanes ahead of ordinary pathing.
requiredTests: held strategic grass tile into an action
safe adjacent star before grass control

protectedBehaviors: Keep safe immediate star pickup when no hard danger exists.
Do not cast overload in a reply-capable direct lane; take a one-frame off-line exit when available, otherwise fire only when already aimed.
Do not step into a long enemy bullet lane while chasing star line.
Treat active enemy overload offset lanes as hard danger even when the enemy cooldown is not ready.
Treat inferred enemy overload offset bullets from visible primary shots as hard bullet danger.
Treat reachable cloak shooter lanes from the enemy's last visible pre-cloak position as hard pressure.
Treat rows or columns exposed by enemy bullets as temporary fixed-shooter pressure.
If currently sitting on an exposed fixed shooter line, take a safe side exit before turning in place or chasing the star.
If currently sitting on a reachable cloak or grass shooter line, take a safe side exit before turning in place.
Do not collect adjacent or near stars that sit inside an enemy overload offset trap.
Do not spend overload setup frames when a safe near star can be collected first.
When a star race is clearly lost, stop blind chasing and convert to star-line pressure or interception.
In overload mirror games, when the star race is clearly lost, open overload or offset pressure before blind star interception.
Preserve covered positive-offset overload attacks.
Ordinary fire must not consume a hard-wall-blocked offset star lane; active overload may still use the covered offset lane.
Do not cast overload for the wrong-side offset lane.
Use vertical overload only on the real positive offset lane.
Active overload should not fire at wrong-side offset targets.
Leave the gunline after overload instead of firing or holding.
Do not fire into an active enemy shield.
Do not chase a low-value far star while already leading on its line.
Do not idle in grass unless it controls a star line or pressure lane.
Grass-control hold frames must submit a real action or fall through; say-only waiting is not a valid strategy action.
Do not treat wall-blocked nearby star lines as strategic grass control.
Strategic grass control may outrank ordinary star pathing only when the grass controls a star line or pressure lane.
Bound grass control path scans to nearby pressure candidates so runtime budget does not consume long games.

publishRequires: pre-publish code quality and strategy-conflict review
challenge dry-run before any real challenge
explicit user confirmation before real challenge execution
stopAfter: new failure not covered by current bounded axis

driftRules: Do not convert one fresh loss directly into code unless the reviewed hard constraint is reproducible or part of a clustered failure axis.
Do not add a new tactical axis without a required regression test.
Do not optimize only from losses; preserve at least one winning behavior.
Do not publish a candidate whose protected behavior tests fail.
Do not keep raw replay dumps as persistent repo context.
Visual speech may add flavor, but it must not change action selection.
Every reviewed replay must emit preserve, fix, hard-constraint, and brave-baseline buckets.
Use real challenge batches as the decision signal; simulation results are safety checks only.
